citationText: 3 . Taken the average directivity of a loudspeaker and the head into account, plus the average reverberation time of a listening room, the home listener sits for lower frequencies (<~3kHz) outside and for higher frequencies inside the critical distance, the border between the direct field and reverberant field. Personal communication Silzle A. , 2014 .
